title: Quick Test
description: Choose a task and connection for functional tests, or load and adjust a performance plan.
manual: Enter address and API Key manually

model.label: Model ID
model.placeholder: Choose a catalog model or enter one
model.empty: No matching model; keep the current input

performance.title: Quick performance test
performance.description: Run a streaming workload with the current connection. Reports are archived after requests are executed.
performance.selectBindingHint: Choose the model and channel for this run. The saved performance profile stays unchanged.
performance.noChannels: No eligible channels for this model
performance.needTarget: Enter a request count or duration
performance.invalid: Performance-test parameters are out of range
performance.error: Quick performance test is unavailable; check local logs
performance.formHint: When both count and duration are set, sending stops when either target is reached. Output tokens are a request limit, not a generation guarantee.
performance.runningHint: Core creates the aggregate report after requests finish.
performance.completeWithFailures: Performance test complete with failed requests
performance.passedHint: All requests completed and passed protocol and semantic validation.
performance.failedHint: The report contains only aggregate metrics and stable error classifications.
performance.notArchived: Performance results were generated but could not be written to the report catalog.
performance.planHint: Load parameters from a plan; adjustments apply only to this test.
performance.noPlans: Configure this test directly, or save reusable performance settings in Plans.

task.valueRequired: Enter a value of the required type.
task.invalidHistory: Invalid quick test history. Refresh and try again.
task.label: Test task
task.emptyHint: Add quick_test metadata to a Suite to make it available here.
task.noHistory: Successful and failed tests will appear here.
task.refreshFailed: The test started, but progress could not be refreshed. Refresh progress without starting again.
task.draftNote: Drafts are saved; temporary keys stay in this session.
task.missingChannel: The original channel is unavailable. Choose another channel or enter a temporary connection.
task.endpointHint: Base or full URL; the gray path is added automatically.
task.performanceUnavailable: This task uses a separate video execution flow.
task.performanceHint: Run a text streaming performance test with the current connection.
task.failure: Operation failed. Check the connection or local logs.
task.rememberedKey: Using the saved key; it is never displayed.
task.rememberFailed: Could not remember the key. Run this connection once, then retry. The accepted test is unaffected.
task.forgetFailed: Could not remove the remembered key. Check the system credential store and retry.
task.unsupportedModelProtocol: This model does not support the selected protocol on this channel.

saveChannel.title: Save as channel
saveChannel.hint: Save the model, selected protocol and channel mapping together. Existing models with the same name are reused and extended with the protocol.
saveChannel.name: Channel name
saveChannel.failed: Could not save the channel. Check the connection details.
